description: 永豐金 Shioaji 官方本機 HTTP server(shioaji server start)的 .NET 10 用戶端,建在 Ozakboy.Http 管線與 Ozakboy.Security 遮罩器之上,不用第三方社群套件。監督官方 server 行程(憑證只走子行程環境變數、不落檔不進日誌)、帳號與商品查詢、聚合 SSE 行情串流(價格一律 decimal)、下單與委託回報(POST 永不重試,逾時標記結果未知)、本地限流預算(行情 10 秒 50 次、帳務 5 秒 25 次、委託 10 秒 250 次、訂閱 200)。0.2.0 加入歷史資料(1 分 K、逐筆、快照等)、流量計與商品全列表;每日流量用完時券商只回空值,回傳頁帶 PossiblyTrafficExhausted 分辨。預期失敗一律回 Result,錯誤碼 shioaji.* 集中在 ShioajiErrorCodes。A .NET 10 client for the official local HTTP server of SinoPac's Shioaji, built on the Ozakboy.Http pipeline and the Ozakboy.Security masker with no third-party community packages. It supervises the official server process (credentials go only through child-process environment variables, never a file or a log), queries accounts and contracts, reads the aggregate SSE market-data stream (prices always decimal), places orders and reads order reports (a POST is never retried, and a timed-out order is flagged as an unknown outcome), and enforces a local rate budget. Version 0.2.0 adds historical data (1-minute bars, ticks, snapshots and more), a traffic meter and a list-everything contract call. Over the daily traffic allowance the broker answers with empty values, so each page carries PossiblyTrafficExhausted. Every expected failure is a Result with a shioaji.* code from ShioajiErrorCodes.
releaseNotes: 0.2.1 — Documentation only; the code and its behaviour are unchanged. The READMEs now state what is tested in the simulation environment and add a "Known server behaviour" section (a 1-minute bar's time is the end of its minute; units of volume and amount; 1-minute bars for indices and futures; traffic figures; the update delay of the usage query). Internal milestone codes and application names are removed from the docs and comments. 0.2.0 — Historical data and a traffic meter. New ShioajiHistoryClient: GetKbarsAsync (1-minute bars; a range over 30 calendar days, both ends counted, is refused locally with shioaji.history.range_too_long), GetTicksAsync (AllDay, RangeTime or LastCount), GetSnapshotsAsync (at most 500 contracts, otherwise shioaji.history.too_many_contracts), GetDailyQuotesAsync, GetScannerAsync, GetShortStockSourcesAsync, GetCreditEnquireAsync, GetRegulatoryPunishAsync and GetRegulatoryNoticeAsync; every call goes through the MarketQuery budget after its local checks. Results are ShioajiHistoryPage<T> {Items, ResponseBytes, IsEmpty, PossiblyTrafficExhausted}: over the daily traffic allowance the broker answers market queries with empty values instead of an error, so an empty page may mean exhausted traffic and not "no data". Column-array responses (kbars and ticks) are read by ShioajiColumnarReader: columns of unequal length fail the whole response with shioaji.history.malformed, a datetime is an ISO string (no offset means Taipei wall-clock time, fixed UTC+8) or an epoch in seconds, milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds by magnitude, and numbers are read from raw text into decimal, never double. ShioajiTrafficMeter (a singleton on a TimeProvider) records the bytes of every response (Content-Length, or the bytes read when chunked), buckets them by Taipei traffic day with the reset at 08:00, exposes TodayBytes, Reset and Snapshot, and receives the usage ShioajiAuthClient.GetUsageAsync reports as ServerReportedBytes. ShioajiContractClient.ListAllContractsAsync walks every page at 500 per page through the MarketQuery budget. ShioajiOptions.DailyQuotesPath overrides the path of the all-market daily OHLCV. UNVERIFIED: that path (default /api/v1/data/daily_quotes, awaiting confirmation against a real server's OpenAPI; the documentation mentions only the command line's `shioaji data daily-quotes`) and its response shape (assumed an array of objects with at least code, open, high, low, close and volume), the request bodies of short_stock_sources and credit_enquire, and the shapes of scanner, short_stock_sources, credit_enquire and the two regulatory lists. Constructor changes: ShioajiApiClient, ShioajiAuthClient and ShioajiContractClient take optional trailing parameters, so existing code keeps compiling. Measured against a real server (simulation) on 2026-10-31: GetKbarsAsync, GetTicksAsync (AllDay), GetUsageAsync, ListAllContractsAsync and GetContractInfoAsync. A bar's Time is the END of its minute (2330: 09:01 to 13:30 each trading day; subtract 1 minute for the open time), Volume is in lots and Amount in TWD; one day of 2330 ticks is about 7,400 rows and 0.4 MB. The other history endpoints are still tested only against the fake server. 0.1.1 — Adjusted to what a real `shioaji server start --no-open` was measured to do on 2026-10-30 (fake credentials). The server is a foreground process that never detaches, so the "exits 0 while still answering" Attached path stays only as a defence. Its output carries ANSI colour codes: the supervisor now strips them line by line before logging and before keeping the last 20 lines. A failed login (output containing "Authentication failed", "login validation error", "invalid secret_key" or "invalid api_key") now returns the dedicated shioaji.server.auth_failed with the masked, stripped line in Error.Data["detail"], and goes straight to Faulted without entering the restart loop, also when it happens during a restart. The `server log: <path>` line printed at start is parsed into the new ShioajiServerStatus.LogFilePath (null when absent). ShioajiCredentials.Validate() and the supervisor now refuse a SecretKey containing characters outside base58 with shioaji.server.invalid_credentials before starting any process, echoing no character; ApiKey is not checked because its format is unknown. Behaviour change: a SecretKey that is not base58 used to start a process that then failed to log in, and now fails locally; ShioajiServerStatus gains the required LogFilePath property. 0.1.0 — First release. ShioajiServerSupervisor starts and supervises the official `shioaji server start --no-open` process (credentials only through child-process environment variables, never a file or a log; every output line masked; Attach mode for an already-running server; mode mismatch refused; backoff restarts up to a limit, then Faulted). ShioajiAuthClient, ShioajiContractClient, ShioajiQuoteClient and ShioajiOrderClient cover /api/v1/info, accounts, usage, stream status, subscribe_trade, contracts, market-data subscription, place_order, update_price, update_qty, cancel_order and trades. The pipeline neither signs nor rate-limits, retries GET only, and never retries a POST; an order that times out or meets a 5xx carries outcomeUnknown=true. ShioajiStreamReader reads the aggregate SSE stream into typed events (stock and futures/options tick, bid-ask and quote, index quote, order report, heartbeat, unknown, lifecycle) with idle detection, backoff reconnection, a post-reconnect replay callback, and a bounded queue that drops the oldest and counts. ShioajiRateBudget enforces market-query 50/10 s, account 25/5 s, order 250/10 s and at most 200 subscriptions locally. Prices and quantities are decimal parsed from raw JSON text, never double; Taipei date and time convert to UTC at a fixed +8. Not run against a real server: the heartbeat format, error-body shape and several response shapes are unmeasured and handled defensively. Not in this release: portfolio, historical data, combo orders, earmarking, watchlist, regulatory lists, and the neutral TradeKit.Abstractions mapping. Full notes: https://github.com/ozakboy/Ozakboy.TradeKit.Shioaji/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
